breakdown.description: `solidDisplacementFoam` models solid deformation and cannot capture the free-surface flow and topology changes of a fluid dam break. A multiphase fluid solver like `interFoam` is required.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses 'interFoam' as the solver instead of the incorrect 'solidDisplacementFoam'. The first line states 'Set up a 2D dam-break simulation using the interFoam solver,' which matches the ground truth requirement for a multiphase fluid solver.
